howto.what: 插件启用后，Claude 会在对话开始和每次用户提交时自动注入项目指令，并在应用补丁后注入匹配的文件规则。不会重写工具输出。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 的行为、注入的项目规则、支持的规则文件位置、匹配规则或环境配置时触发。

say.text: 告诉我如何配置 Codex Rules 的环境变量？
say.note: 会返回支持的环境变量及其作用。

say.text: 列出 Codex Rules 支持的规则文件位置。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude injects static project instructions on session start and user prompt submit, and injects matching file-specific rules after apply_patch by default. It deduplicates dynamic output per session and does not rewrite tool output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching logic, or environment configuration.

say_en.text: How do I configure Codex Rules environment variables?
say_en.note: Returns supported environment knobs and their effects.
